name: sajha_search_docs
description:
Search SAJHA's documentation (guides, configuration reference, tutorials, tool reference guides) and any document sources an administrator configured; no LLM involved.
Returns: query, count and results, best first, each with citation (number), source, document, title, section, url (help-page link for SAJHA guides, else null), score and text (the passage, cut to 500 characters).
Inputs (* required): query* (plain words; a question works); top_k (1-20; default 3); source (only this source: sajha_docs, uploads or a configured source's name).
Needs the document index (ai.rag.enabled); otherwise the call fails saying document search is off. For an answer written from the passages use llm_docs_qa where enabled.
Example: {"query": "configure the redis state backend", "top_k": 5}

query.description: What to look for, in plain words (a question works).

source.description: Only this source: sajha_docs, uploads, or a configured source's name.
